synthesis: The Scout hit modal in DayOverlay.vue (and its counterpart TripOverlay.vue) is a full-viewport teleport overlay (`fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center`) — it covers the entire map and entirely obscures whichever marker was tapped (AC-1). The modal currently shows plate + timestamp + two images; it needs to also display make/model/year/color from the hotlist (AC-2). Those vehicle fields (vehicle_year, vehicle_make, vehicle_model) ARE present in hits_cold/hits_hot schemas and already propagated by the hits_cold_mv, but are NOT selected by the ClarityScoutTripsController day()/show() endpoints — so backend work is needed to include them. Vehicle color comes from scan metadata (ScanMetaData.vehicle_color), which is a different source not currently joined in the Scout CH queries. Vehicle state is the hotlist's us_state (hotlist_us_state in hits_cold). The DEV-2052 type-label mechanism lives in MapShell.vue as a computed `hitTypeLabel` mapping hit_type L→'Direct Live', S→'Staging Live'; the same pattern can be copied into DayOverlay.vue since the hits_detail payload already carries hit_type.

scope.summary: Two-part frontend+backend change: (1) reposition the modal so it anchors offset from the marker rather than covering it; (2) add vehicle info fields (year/make/model + type label) to the modal, requiring a backend select expansion to expose those fields from hits_cold.
proposed_changes: DayOverlay.vue (lines 244–282): Replace the bespoke `fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70` hit-lightbox with the EXISTING BottomSheet.vue component (already imported + used for the 'Route Overview' panel at DayOverlay.vue:103). It floats at bottom-28/z-30 above the bottom-nav pill, with drag handle + light backdrop — no new positioning logic, consistent UX, and resolves AC-1 by construction (the marker above the sheet stays visible).

DayOverlay.vue modal body (now inside BottomSheet slot): Add type label (hit_type L/S → 'Direct Live'/'Staging Live' badge, same classes as MapShell.vue hitTypeLabel), and a vehicle info row (year make model + registration state) with v-if guards for nullable values. vehicle_color is DEFERRED (not included).
TripOverlay.vue (lines 157–196): Identical modal markup — apply same positioning fix and vehicle info additions to stay in sync.

ClarityScoutTripsController.php day() (line 295): Expand .select([...]) to include 'vehicle_year', 'vehicle_make', 'vehicle_model', 'hotlist_us_state'; add them to the hitsDetail array (lines 350–361).
ClarityScoutTripsController.php show() (line 446): Same select and payload expansion for the trip detail endpoint (lines 461–469).
Cache key bump on day() and show() if schema of cached payload changes (prevent stale cached responses missing new fields).
out_of_scope: vehicle_color from scan metadata — not in hits_cold; would require a separate PG or scan_metadata join not currently done in this CH-only endpoint. Defer unless explicitly approved.
MapShell.vue modal (map-hit markers) — already updated by DEV-2052; only Trips/Day overlay modals are in scope.
New ClickHouse schema changes — vehicle_year/make/model/hotlist_us_state already exist in hits_cold.
Hit type label on the SidePanel list rows (compact view) — ticket only specifies the modal.

acceptance_criteria.text: Modal does not obscure its associated marker across common screen sizes/scales (small laptop + tablet).
acceptance_criteria.reason: Current `fixed inset-0` backdrop + centered card definitely obscures the marker. Fix: position the card toward a screen edge (e.g. bottom-sheet on <768px, top-offset card on ≥768px) so the map marker area remains partially visible, or shift the card to bottom half of the screen. The specific approach needs design approval (see questions).

acceptance_criteria.text: Modal shows relevant vehicle info for the selected hit, labeled by type (Direct/Staging Live).
acceptance_criteria.reason: vehicle_year, vehicle_make, vehicle_model exist in hits_cold schema. hit_type is already in the hits_detail payload (line 355/465 of controller). Type label pattern is already built in MapShell.vue (DEV-2052). Backend select expansion is straightforward. vehicle_color is NOT in hits_cold — defer or explicitly approve a separate lookup.

questions.q: Approve the modal-repositioning approach + the exact vehicle fields to surface?
questions.answer: Reuse the existing BottomSheet.vue component for the hit modal (it floats at bottom-28 / z-30, ABOVE the floating bottom-nav pill at bottom-8/z-40, with drag handle + light bg-black/20 backdrop) — consistent with the 'Route Overview' BottomSheet already used in DayOverlay.vue. This clears the bottom nav by offset (no overlap, no z-fight) and grows upward (max-h 70vh, scroll). Vehicle fields to surface: vehicle_year + vehicle_make + vehicle_model + hotlist_us_state (registration state), labeled by hit_type via the DEV-2052 hitTypeLabel pattern.

questions.q: Is vehicle_color (PG ScanMetaData, not hits_cold) in scope?
questions.answer: DEFER vehicle_color. No secondary PG lookup this ticket — ship year/make/model + hotlist_us_state from ClickHouse (hits_cold) only. Note the deferral in the Build Record; color can be a follow-up.

grounding.code_flow: User taps hit row in SidePanel → `selectedHit = hit` (DayOverlay.vue:217) → teleported modal renders with `fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/70` backdrop covering the full viewport → modal card shows plate + time + two images. The hit object is populated from `dayDetail.hits_detail` (computed via `trips.dayDetail.hits_detail`), which is fetched by `trips.fetchDayDetail(date)` → GET /api/scout/trips/day/{date} → `ClarityScoutTripsController::day()`. The controller's hits query selects only [ocr, hit_created_at, hit_type, lat, lng, scan_guid] from hits_cold — vehicle fields are NOT selected. vehicle_year/make/model exist as Nullable(String) columns in hits_cold (confirmed in schema). DEV-2052 type label lives in MapShell.vue as `hitTypeLabel` computed from `hit_type` L→'Direct Live', S→'Staging Live'.
related_components: resources/js/clarity-scout/components/MapShell.vue (DEV-2052 type label, same hit payload pattern)
app/Http/Controllers/Api/ClarityScoutMapController.php (hits() endpoint — already returns hit_type; DEV-2052 already done)

data_impact.mv_or_cdc_implications: No schema changes needed. vehicle_year/make/model/hotlist_us_state already exist in hits_cold (CDC-populated via hits_cold_mv). Only the SELECT list in the controller changes — no migrations required.
data_impact.notes: Cache key for scanner:day:{orgId}:{kitId}:{date} and scanner:trip should be bumped (append :v2 or similar) to avoid returning stale cached payloads that lack the new vehicle fields after deploy.

tests.what_it_pins: Existing day() and show() controller tests — extend insertHitCold() / insertHitHot() helpers to include vehicle_year/make/model/hotlist_us_state, and add assertions that hits_detail items carry those fields (nullable-aware). Also add hit_type assertion if not already present.

escalate.reason: Both changes are self-contained frontend+controller work with no new migrations or external dependencies. The open questions are design/scope choices (repositioning approach + exact vehicle fields), not technical blockers. Once answered, implementation is straightforward.

gate_reasons: Design approved (human:dalton 2026-06-18): reuse BottomSheet.vue for the hit modal; surface year/make/model + state, labeled by hit_type.
vehicle_color scope resolved: DEFERRED (CH-only, no PG lookup this ticket).
